cloud_model.description: Gemini model used for cloud inference (hybrid fallback, chat, prompt shaping).

transcribe_model.description: Gemini model used to transcribe recordings in the cloud (audio is not supported on-device).

device_char_budget.description: Input size (characters) above which Automatic routing prefers the cloud. Gemini Nano's limit is 9216 tokens for input plus output.

transcribe_chunk_seconds.description: Recordings are transcribed in chunks of this many seconds so long recordings stay under the inline request size limit.
